evidence: Schwab Developer Portal confirms a sanctioned OAuth 2.0 developer platform with real-time API products for self-directed traders.
Current Schwab One International account terms state there is no current account-opening minimum; older $10k/$25k documents are stale and are not used as the blocker.

Schwab's market-data agreements cover real-time quotations under NYSE/CTA/CQ/Nasdaq subscriber arrangements, but the current primary-source free Schwab streaming path identified in Schwab materials is proprietary/partial rather than strict National NBBO; streaming NBBO is separately fee-bearing.

Current Schwab Trader API implementations consistently expose a realtime NBBO quote schema with separate bidTime, askTime/quoteTime and tradeTime fields; this is strong technical B evidence but does not override entitlement authority.

The official Developer Portal auth page is live but its crawled public text does not expose token TTLs. Current Trader-API reference implementations and archived Schwab-auth documentation consistently report 30-minute access tokens and a 7-day refresh-token hard expiry, after which the browser authorization-code flow must be repeated by the user.

A seven-day interactive reauthorization wall is incompatible with XRAY's indefinite unattended scheduler-callability requirement D even if quote schema and account eligibility are otherwise sufficient.

Therefore Schwab has two independent current blockers under XRAY: permanent-$0 strict National-NBBO entitlement is not proven/free, and indefinite unattended D fails on recurrent human OAuth reauthorization.

gate_assessment.B: TECHNICALLY_STRONG_REALTIME_NBBO_SCHEMA_WITH_SEPARATE_QUOTE_AND_TRADE_TIMES; LIVE_RTH PROBE WOULD STILL BE REQUIRED

account_gate_note: Schwab data aggregation could be a sanctioned read-only account-data architecture only if the user actually has an eligible Schwab account and an approved aggregator/connector is connectable in this workspace; neither is currently proven.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if current Schwab primary sources both (1) grant consolidated National-NBBO Trader-API entitlement permanently at $0 for the exact automated/non-display use and (2) provide a sanctioned noninteractive credential mechanism that remains renewable indefinitely without periodic human/browser authorization. Then prove Turkey account eligibility and run same-RTH quote/trade freshness.
